_note: COPY THIS TO .hearth-local/sandbox-recipients.json AND FILL IT IN. That path is gitignored. Sandbox account addresses are account details, not fixture data, so they never go in data/willow-court.mjs and never go in a commit. No password, client ID or client secret belongs in this file either — those go in .env.

invoicer._note: The sandbox BUSINESS account. It is the seller of record on every invoice: the fictional landlord. PayPal requires the invoicer email to be this account's own primary email.

recipients._note: Fictional resident id -> sandbox PERSONAL account email. The sandbox delivers mail only inside itself, so a recipient must be a sandbox account. One sandbox personal account can stand in for every resident: each still gets their own invoice. The p-ca ids are the twelve residents of 140 College Ave (the default); p-3a-devi is in the Willow Court scenario. An unmapped resident is shown as "No PayPal email" and is never invoiced or substituted.
